metadata.name: SearchNetworkAccount
metadata.description: This API is used to Search the Account Related to a Network.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: InstitutioUnique identification number for Institution. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.nID

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Condition: Mandatory if First Name, Last Name and SSNLast4Digits is Not Provided. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First Name of the Account Holder Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Condition:Mandatory if Account Number not inputted Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last Name of the Account Holder. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Lee Condition:Mandatory if Account Number not inputted. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: This tag reflect the last 4 digit of SSN . SSNLast4Digits of the Account Holder Condition:Mandatory if Account Number not inputted. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Description: Unique number of merchant account. Can provide multiple Merchant Number with comma separator Valid Values: As provided by CoreCard Example: 35632

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: OriginatingMerchantName
children.description: Name of the Merchant under which Account was originated. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Allowable Values: 40

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: FirstName
children.description: First Name of the Account Holder Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastName
children.description: Last Name of the Account Holder. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Lee Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CoApplicantFirstName
children.description: Co- Applicant’s First Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 40

children.name: CoApplicantLastName
children.description: Co-Applicant’s Last Name Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Davis Allowable Values: 40

children.name: PreQualDate
children.description: This tag refer to Pre qualification date. Valid Values: Format:MM/DD/YYY HH:MM:SS Example: 12/23/2019 06:36:14

children.name: PreQualID
children.description: This tag refer to Pre qualification ID. Allowable Values: 15

children.name: PreQualStatus
children.description: This tag refer to Pre qualification Status. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ApprovedPrequalAmount
children.description: Approved Pre qualification Amount before the final review. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: ApplicationDate
children.description: Date when the Application was Submitted.

children.name: ApplicationNumber
children.description: Number Generated for the Application Allowable Values: 15

children.name: ApplicationStatus
children.description: Status of the Application Example: Approved/Declined/Review

children.name: CreditLimit
children.description: Credit Limit of account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: OpenToBuy
children.description: Remaining Limit which can be used for further posting. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXX.XX Example:200.00
